The wideout remains another inconsistent option as part of an underperforming Miami offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.analysis: McPherson made field goals from 43 and 57 yards out to help pace the Bengals to their sixth win of the season. McPherson continues to have an excellent season and will look to continue that against the Steelers in Week 10.
news.contents: Evan McPherson connected on both of his field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.title: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 9 win

news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals kicker Evan McPherson made all five of his extra-point attempts in last week's win over the Tennessee Titans. With those five kicks, McPherson extended his streak of perfection this season. The Bengals kicker has yet to miss a kick this season, nailing 24 extra-point attempts and 10 field goals. news.title: J.J. McCarthy (hip) questionable to return

news.contents: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (hip) returned to Sunday's Week 9 game against the Philadelphia Eagles on the final play of the third quarter. McCarthy had been listed as questionable after taking a hit from Eagles linebacker Zack Baun on a designed run earlier in the quarter. Before leaving, McCarthy completed nine of 13 passes for 101 yards and ran three times for 11 yards. Jameis Winston led a 14-play, 76-yard drive in McCarthy's absence and threw a five-yard touchdown pass to ...

news.analysis: Meyers continues to operate as the third wide receiver in the offense, but has not seen more than three targets since Week 4. Fantasy managers can leave the rookie out of starting lineups heading into Week 10.
news.contents: Dohnte Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 47 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. He rushed for 16 yards on one carry.
news.title: Dohnte Meyers hauls in two passes in Week 9 win

news.analysis: Sutton scored from three yards out in the first quarter for his first touchdown since Week 1. He also led Denver with nine targets, nearly doubling his four targets from Week 8. That's the good. The bad? Sutton still hasn't surpassed 60 receiving yards in a game this season. The touchdown helps, but one productive fantasy performance doesn't erase eight weeks of limited production.
news.contents: Courtland Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.title: Courtland Sutton catches touchdown in Week 9

news.contents: Denver Broncos wide receiver Courtland Sutton had season highs in catches (five) and targets (nine) while recording 45 receiving yards and his second touchdown of the season in the team's 26-21 win on the road over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday in Week 9. The production was nothing special, but the 31-year-old veteran's elevated line in comparison to the rest of his season came with fellow receiver Jaylen Waddle being ruled out after suffering a head injury early in the game. He has just five catches over his last three games, and Denver continues to spread targets among several receivers. The former second-round pick doesn't have enough receiving volume to justify a fantasy roster spot in most leagues.

Robinson has recorded 53 carries for 211 yards and four touchdowns across six appearances, with three of those scores coming against the New ...

news.title: Mike Washington Jr. struggles Sunday

news.contents: It was a tough day, to say the least, for Las Vegas Raiders running back Mike Washington Jr. in a 38-17 loss to the San Francisco 49ers in Week 9. The rookie tailback recorded six carries and totaled minus-three yards on the day, and he was not targeted in the passing game. The Raiders were playing from behind for most of the contest and likely had to abandon the running game fairly early. This bust of a performance comes one week after Washington set career highs in rushing attempts (25), ...
